battle.name: 兩井之戰
battle.brief: 垂拱二年（686）九月，後突厥可汗骨咄祿犯河東道北部，唐將黑齒常之率二百騎迎擊於兩井，乘突厥兵下馬穿甲、陣腳未固之際猛衝破之；傍晚敵主力趕到，常之砍木燃火於營中偽作烽燧，使敵疑有援兵而退。卡面羅馬短劍雖未用於此役，其以刺突制勝之道，正是此戰決勝的邏輯。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 交戰雙方是唐王朝與後突厥汗國。開戰時唐朝處在武則天臨朝稱制、尚未正式改唐為周的時期，垂拱二年（686）九月，執政的朝廷下令河東道沿邊各軍出戰，主帥是黑齒常之，時任左鷹揚衛大將軍，領兵二百騎出塞迎敵，隸屬河東道邊防體系。河東道是唐十道之一，治所在蒲州，北境與突厥控制區相接，邊軍以募兵為主，兼收鐵勒諸部的蕃兵，府兵舊制此時已大半崩解，長從、健兒與歸附部眾才是野戰主力。另一方是後突厥汗國，骨咄祿可汗為頗利可汗長子，貞觀末年其父在幽州被唐軍擒獲，他本人流落漠北，於永淳初年自立為汗，重建牙帳於蒙古高原，控制草原諸部。汗國以大、小都督與俟斤分統部落，兵員以騎兵為絕對主體，骨角弓與標槍並用，騎士多備數匹換馬，行軍不帶重車，糧秣靠酪酥、風乾肉與沿途劫掠，徵發不必等待詔令，劫掠所得即為軍資。兩國在686年秋並非全面開戰式的國戰，而是一次邊防巡邏與越境掠奪之間的遭遇；唐廷仍想用封爵與和親維持羈縻，突厥則以南下掠邊試探唐軍虛實，這一相互試探的背景，決定了兩井一役規模雖小卻被各方重視。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tang dynasty and the khaganate of the Second Turkic Khaganate. The Tang was at that moment under Empress Wu, who exercised power as a regent from the empress dowager's residence but had not yet proclaimed the Zhou dynasty; in the ninth month of Chui'gong 2 (686) the court at Luoyang ordered the frontier commands of Hedong Dao into the field. The Tang commander was Heichi Changzhi, then Left Yingyang Guard Great General, who took two hundred cavalry out to meet the raiders as part of the Hedong frontier establishment. Hedong Dao was one of the Tang's ten circuits, administered from Puzhou, and its northern frontier abutted territory held by the Turks. By 686 the old fubing militia system had largely collapsed, so the field army consisted chiefly of recruited soldiers, changcong and jian'er, supplemented by auxiliaries drawn from the Tiele and other tribes. The other side was the Second Turkic Khaganate under Khagan Guduolu, eldest son of Jieli Khan: after his father was captured by Tang forces at Youzhou in the late Zhenguan era, Guduolu himself wandered in the northern steppe, raised a new yurt of his own in the early Yongchun reign and rebuilt control over the steppe tribes on the Mongolian plateau. The khanate organised its people into great and lesser dudu and sirqin commands, and cavalry made up the overwhelming core of its army, combining composite bone-and-horn bows with javelins, carrying several horses per rider, travelling without heavy baggage trains, and living on cheese, dried meat and plunder taken along the way; mobilisation did not require imperial orders, and what was taken in raid became the army's supply. What happened at Two Wells in the autumn of 686 was not a general war between two states but a collision between a frontier patrol and a raiding force, and it has to be read against a background in which the Tang still tried to hold the Turks through investiture and marriage while the Turks probed Tang readiness with repeated raids.
people: 兩井之戰有兩位真正決定勝負的人。唐方主將黑齒常之是鐵勒突騎施人，出身部族，自少年起在裴行儉麾下效力，先後隨軍平定西突厥阿史那都支之亂、鎮壓突厥反將伏念，累積邊地經驗；他曾以左鷹揚衛大將軍身分出擊突厥而無功被貶，鬱鬱不得志數年，到垂拱二年才重新得到起用。資治通鑑記他在青海之役中擔任副總管，與論欽陵大軍相持，是唐朝在西北少數幾次倚重蕃將取勝的戰例；他真正嶄露頭角，是在中亞的青海與大非川一線頂住吐蕃攻勢。此次兩井之戰，他只帶二百騎，卻抓住突厥兵下馬穿甲、尚未列陣的短暫空隙反覆衝撞，事後又以砍伐樹木、營中燃火偽作烽燧的辦法嚇退敵方主力，顯示其戰術性格偏向奇襲與心理戰而非正面對耗。突厥一方，骨咄祿自父汗被擒後流落漠北，憑個人武力與部族歸附重建汗庭，屢次入犯河東、河北，與唐廷時打時談。他以三千騎先鋒試探邊防，又親率大軍在同日傍晚趕到，兩次出手都指向唐軍虛實；然而此役之後他並未收手，北方邊患延續多年。事後在朝堂上，黑齒常之因武則天青睞而進封燕國公、掌兵柄，卻在權力傾軋中於永昌元年（689）以謀反罪名被誅，舊唐書本傳與新唐書列傳對他謀反的說法並無一致記載，諸說並存，可以確定的是他死於政治而非戰場。
peopleEn: Two men really decided the outcome of this fight. On the Tang side, Heichi Changzhi was a Tiele man of the Chuoqixi tribe, the son of a chieftain, who had served under Pei Xingjian from his youth, taking part in the campaign against the Western Turk Ashina Duzhi and in the suppression of the rebel Turk Fonian, and had in the process accumulated hard experience on the frontier. He had campaigned against the Turks in the rank of Left Yingyang Guard Great General, was demoted for want of success, and remained frustrated and sidelined for several years until he was called back to command in Chui'gong 2. The Zizhi Tongjian records him as deputy commander at the Battle of Qinghai, where he stood against the army of the Tibetan minister Lunqinling, one of the few occasions on which the Tang won in the northwest largely by trusting frontier auxiliaries; his true fame, however, came in the central Asian theatre, where he held the line at Qinghai and Dafuichuan against Tibetan pressure. At Two Wells he brought only two hundred cavalry, yet he seized the instant when the Turk riders dismounted to pull on their armour and had not yet formed up, and rode them down; in the evening, when the main Turk host reached the field, he had his men cut down trees and light fires inside the camp so that the distant enemy would mistake them for beacon fires and, believing reinforcements were on the way, break off and go. His tactical temperament clearly leaned towards surprise and psychological pressure rather than grinding attrition in a set-piece engagement. On the Turk side, Guduolu, having lost his father to Tang captivity and spent long years in the northern steppe, rebuilt his khanate on personal prowess and the adherence of the tribes, raided Hedong and Hebei again and again, and fought and negotiated with the Tang court by turns. He tested the Tang with a vanguard of three thousand riders and brought his main body to the same battlefield by evening, both moves aimed at measuring Tang strength; yet he did not stop after Two Wells, and the northern threat persisted for years afterwards. In the capital, Heichi Changzhi rose to favour under Empress Wu, was created Duke of Yan and given command of troops, but was caught in the factional struggles of the Wu Zhou court and executed in Yongchang 1 (689) on a charge of plotting rebellion. The Jiu Tangshu biography and the Xin Tangshu do not agree on the substance of that accusation and several readings survive; what is certain is that he died in politics, not on the battlefield.
kits: 卡面所配的兵器是羅馬短劍（Gladius），約公元前100年前後定型，劍身約六十至七十公分，雙刃而尖端收窄，配圓盤形大護手，握柄以肋片與皮纏紮，單手握持時重心靠前，專為刺擊而非劈砍設計；羅馬劍士把它與大盾（scutum）搭配，靠盾面掩護與齊整的縱深陣形向前推進。需要說明的是，兩井之戰發生在唐與後突厥之間，兩軍都不可能裝備這件兵器，卡面是以它代表一類戰術原理：接觸瞬間以刺突決定勝負的直刃短兵。實際登上戰場的雙方兵器如下：唐軍邊騎的標準裝備是環首直刃橫刀一柄，佩於腰左，配長槊一杆、角弓一張並附箭袋，著明光鎧與鎧馬，馬具用木鞍皮帶與鐵鐙，並備數匹草原馬輪換；步兵另有陌刀與擘張弩，邊軍還備拒馬與器材，遠距交鋒仍以角弓與弩機為主。後突厥騎士的骨架武器是骨角複合弓，筋木角三者分層膠合，弓張有限而拉力可觀，配鐵鏃箭；近身用標槍、套索與短刃佩刀，佩刀多骨柄環首，風乾肉與乳酪隨身攜帶，甲胄以皮甲為主，鐵札甲只有少數精騎才有，鎧馬比例也低於唐軍。刀劍的用法在兩軍幾乎一致：騎兵錯身時以刺為主，砍劈只是退而求其次的變通。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face is the Roman gladius, a form settled by about 100 BC: the blade ran some sixty to seventy centimetres, was double-edged with a narrow point, and was fitted with a broad disc-shaped guard, the grip being bound with leather over ribbed strips, so that held in one hand the mass sat forward, and the design served the thrust rather than the cut; the Roman swordsman carried it together with the large scutum, advancing in a disciplined column behind the cover of his shield. It should be said plainly that the battle of Two Wells was fought between the Tang and the Second Turks, and neither side could have had this weapon; the card stands for a tactical principle instead, that of the straight-edged short blade which decides a fight at the moment of contact by the thrust. The weapons actually on the field were as follows. The standard kit of a Tang frontier horseman was a ring-pommelled single-edged crosswise sword worn on the left of the waist, together with a long spear, a horn bow and a quiver of arrows; he wore bright armour and horse armour, his tack used a wooden saddle with leather straps and iron stirrups, and he carried several steppe horses for rotation. The foot soldiers had long dao and powerful crossbows, and the frontier lines also kept cheval-de-frise and engineering stores, with the bow and the crossbow remaining the main instruments of fighting at distance. The principal weapon of a Turk rider was the composite bone-and-horn bow, in which horn, sinew and wood were laminated in layers, limited in draw but powerful in tension, and fitted with iron-tipped arrows; at close quarters they used javelins, lasso and short blades, the fighting knives usually ring-pommelled with bone grips. Dried meat and cheese were carried with them, their armour was mainly hide, and only the pick of the cavalry had iron lamellar, the proportion of armoured horses being lower than in the Tang army. In the use of blades the two sides were almost identical: when horsemen passed each other at close range, the thrust came first and the cut was only a fallback.
tactics: 兩井之戰是一場教科書式的邊防遭遇戰，其流程在資治通鑑中保存了完整骨架。第一步是巡邏接敵：黑齒常之率二百騎在河東道北部沿邊巡邏，撞見後突厥三千騎兵前鋒，兩軍在開闊地帶猝然相接。第二步是抓空隙：突厥兵看到唐軍人數少，索性下馬穿甲，準備步戰或整理裝備，而甲胄穿了一半正是全軍最脆弱的瞬間；黑齒常之立刻抓住這個空檔，率二百騎全速衝入，把對方打散，逼得突厥兵棄甲而走。第三步是不貪功、不戀戰，及時收兵：唐騎沒有在追擊中散開，維持著可隨時再發動衝鋒的密集隊形。第四步是欺敵：當日傍晚，突厥主力趕到，準備與唐軍會戰，黑齒常之命人砍伐樹木，在營中燃起大火，故意讓遠方看見疑似烽燧的火光，突厥誤以為河東道烽火已起、援軍將至，遂棄陣退走。第五步是收尾：唐軍未追入草原，僅在邊界一帶搜索殘敵、繳獲散落的甲兵。整場戰鬥的勝負並不取決於兵力對比，而取決於對時機的判讀與對敵人心理的利用：二百人吃掉三千人靠的是節奏而不是消耗，偽烽火則讓敵人自己放棄了再戰的機會。從更大的防線看，唐朝的烽燧制度本就是沿邊郡縣向北傳警的網絡，兩井之役正好借用了這套制度在敵人心中的權威。
tacticsEn: The battle of Two Wells is a textbook frontier encounter, and the Zizhi Tongjian preserves its full skeleton. The first step was the meeting on patrol: Heichi Changzhi was riding with two hundred cavalry along the northern frontier of Hedong Dao when he ran into a Turk vanguard of three thousand horsemen, and the two sides collided suddenly in open country. The second step was the exploitation of a gap. Seeing that the Tang force was small, the Turk riders dismounted to put on their armour, preparing to fight on foot or to sort out their equipment, and men half-dressed in their armour were at their most vulnerable; Heichi Changzhi seized that moment at once, drove two hundred riders in at full speed, broke the enemy formation and forced the Turks to abandon their armour and flee. The third step was restraint: not claiming too much, not lingering in pursuit. The Tang cavalry did not scatter while chasing, but kept a close formation from which a fresh charge could be launched at any moment. The fourth step was the deception. That same evening the main Turk force arrived and prepared to give battle, and Heichi Changzhi ordered his men to cut down trees and light large fires inside the camp, deliberately placing what looked like beacon fires in the enemy's sight; the Turks, believing the beacon system of Hedong Dao had been lit and that reinforcements were coming, abandoned the field and withdrew. The fifth step was mopping up: the Tang did not pursue into the steppe, but searched the border zone for stragglers and recovered scattered armour and weapons. The outcome of the whole engagement was decided neither by the balance of numbers nor by endurance, but by the reading of the moment and by the manipulation of the enemy's expectations: two hundred men beat three thousand by rhythm rather than by consumption of man power, and the false beacon fires made the enemy give up the chance to fight again on his own account. Seen from the wider defensive system, the Tang beacon network was the means by which the frontier commanderies passed warnings northward, and the battle at Two Wells borrowed precisely the authority that this system held in the enemy's mind.
data: 關於此役可以核對的數字極少，都來自資治通鑑卷二百四唐紀二十的數十字記載：交戰時間在垂拱二年（686）九月；唐方出戰兵力為二百騎兵，突厥方為三千人，兵力比約一比十五；交戰地點記作兩井，屬河東道北部，今山西境內，具體位置已不可考，中文維基的分類仍把此役列在山西省戰役之下。當日交鋒之後，突厥主力於傍晚抵達戰場，說明先鋒與主力之間的距離在半日行程之內，兩井距河東道治所蒲州的里程史無明文，不能臆造。雙方陣亡數字史書一律記作不詳，沒有斬首與俘虜的統計，因此任何精確傷亡數都屬編造。可以交代的是編制背景：唐軍二百騎大致相當於邊軍一個折衝府或一團騎兵的規模，府兵舊制在686年已名存實亡，出征主力是長從、健兒等募兵與蕃兵；後突厥是草原游牧政權，歷來史書以控弦數十萬概括其總兵源，這是歷朝的概括說法而非686年的實測統計。史料厚度也需說明：兩井一役的細節主要依賴資治通鑑的簡筆，舊唐書黑齒常之傳與新唐書北狄傳雖分別記了相關人物與後突厥的活動，卻未留下戰役過程的完整數據。
dataEn: Very few figures about this engagement can be checked, and all of them come from a few dozen characters in volume 204 of the Zizhi Tongjian, in the annals of Chui'gong. The date of the fighting was the ninth month of Chui'gong 2 (686). The Tang force that took the field numbered two hundred cavalry; the Turk force numbered three thousand, a ratio of roughly one to fifteen. The place of contact is given as Two Wells, in the northern part of Hedong Dao, within present-day Shanxi, the exact site no longer being recoverable; the Chinese Wikipedia classification still files the battle among the engagements of Shanxi province. Because the Turk main body reached the battlefield by evening on the same day, the distance between vanguard and main body lay within half a day's ride; the mileage from Two Wells to Puzhou, the seat of Hedong Dao, is nowhere recorded and must not be invented. Casualty figures are given by the histories simply as unknown: there is no count of heads taken and no count of prisoners, so any precise loss figure would be fabrication. What can responsibly be set out is the structural background. Two hundred horsemen was on the order of one zhechong fu, or one cavalry unit, of the frontier army; the old fubing system existed in name only by 686, and the field army consisted of recruited men such as changcong and jian'er together with tribal auxiliaries. The Second Turkic Khaganate was a nomadic polity on the steppe, and the Chinese histories habitually summarise its total manpower as several hundred thousand bowmen; that is a conventional figure for the Turks across the centuries rather than a measured statistic for 686. The thickness of the record must also be stated: the details of Two Wells rest mainly on the brevity of the Zizhi Tongjian, and while the Jiu Tangshu biography of Heichi Changzhi and the Xin Tangshu account of the northern tribes record the relevant personalities and the activities of the Second Turks, neither preserves a full set of data on the course of the battle.
cause: 直接起因是後突厥可汗骨咄祿在686年秋再次率眾南下，進犯河東道北部，試圖掠取邊州的糧秣、牲畜與人口。唐初以來的策略是邊防與羈縻並用：對突厥既在沿線布置軍州、修築城障與烽燧，又以封爵、賜物、互市甚至和親維持和平，骨咄祿也曾接受唐朝的官號與賞賜，雙方維持著隨時可能破裂的表面穩定。686年的破裂點在於邊防實際狀態與朝廷期望之間的落差：武則天執政初期朝中清洗的氣氛正在醞釀，邊軍精銳被抽調、補充不易，糧秣調度亦常遲滯，關內與河東一段的巡邏密度明顯低於開元盛世；骨咄祿正是在秋高馬壯、部落無事可做的季節選擇南掠。他之所以敢以三千騎深入而無顧大軍在側，也因為汗位繼承的內部矛盾削弱了後突厥的整體調度：各部以劫掠為目的自行其是，進退不聽統一號令，許多部眾並不打算作深遠遠征，只要遇到唐軍設防嚴整的邊州便自行退去。加上兩國之間的封賞與使節往來雖未完全斷絕，次數卻已稀疏，關係維繫主要靠零星交易，唐廷對骨咄祿的約束力明顯下降，衝突最終由一次試探性的越境掠奪，釀成了兵戎相見。
causeEn: The immediate cause was that in the autumn of 686 the Second Turkic Khagan Guduolu led his people south again, raiding the northern part of Hedong Dao in the hope of carrying off grain, livestock and people from the frontier prefectures. Tang policy from the early dynasty onward combined defence with pacification: along the line were stationed military departments, with city works and beacon towers raised, and at the same time the court used investiture, gifts, markets and even marriage to hold the Turks in place; Guduolu had himself accepted Tang titles and rewards, and the two sides maintained a surface stability that could break at any moment. The point of rupture in 686 lay in the gap between the real state of the frontier and what the court expected of it. In the first years of Empress Wu's rule the atmosphere of purges was forming, picked troops were being drawn off the frontier and were hard to replace, the movement of grain and fodder was often delayed, and the density of patrols in the Guan region and in northern Hedong was plainly lower than it would be in the Kaiyuan era. Guduolu chose to raid south precisely in the season when the grass was high, the horses strong and the tribes with nothing else to do. His confidence in leading three thousand riders deep inland without covering forces close at hand also rested on the internal contradictions of Turkic succession: the tribes moved in their own interest, took what they could seize, and did not follow a single order of march, many of them having no intention of a distant campaign and turning back as soon as they met a border prefecture defended in depth. And although the exchange of investitures and envoys between the two states had not completely ceased, it had grown sparse, with the relationship kept going by occasional transactions, so that the Tang hold over Guduolu had plainly loosened, and what began as a probing raid across the border ended in open fighting.
impact: 兩井之戰的直接影響主要落在兩個方面。對唐朝邊防而言，此役是武則天用人得當的典型案例：二百騎破三千人、全日逼退敵軍主力，證明當邊軍精銳與宿將尚在時，草原部落並非不可擊敗；黑齒常之自此嶄露頭角，其後在武周朝接連升遷，進封燕國公並取得兵權，一度是武則天倚重於北方防務的人選；兩井式的欺敵手法——以少量兵力的營火假作烽燧、利用敵人對邊軍預警制度的熟悉——也被後世兵書與戰例彙編反覆引用，成為中國古代邊防遭遇戰的典型素材。對黑齒常之本人而言，這場勝利同時是一個悲劇的起點：他因軍功得寵而捲入武周高層的權力傾軋，最終在永昌元年（689）以謀反罪名被誅，唐朝在北方最熟悉突厥作戰的將領就此消失。對北方局勢而言，兩井的挫敗並未終止邊患，骨咄祿之後仍多次南侵，直到後突厥內部因汗位繼承與部族矛盾而分裂，才真正為唐朝騰出空間。史書對此役著墨極少，但它在兩千年來的軍事敘事中留下了自己的位置：少數兵力、極短時間、完全依靠節奏與心理戰取勝的邊疆遭遇戰。
impactEn: The immediate consequences of the battle of Two Wells fell to a good degree in two directions. For Tang frontier defence it was a textbook case of the right man in the right place: two hundred cavalry broke three thousand and turned the main enemy force back within a single day, which showed that while the frontier troops and experienced commanders were still there, the steppe tribes were not invulnerable. Heichi Changzhi came to the fore from that moment, was promoted repeatedly in the Wu Zhou court, was created Duke of Yan and given command of troops, and for a time was the figure Empress Wu relied on for northern defence. The method used at Two Wells, making camp fires in the shape of beacon fires with a tiny force and turning the enemy's familiarity with the frontier warning system against him, was quoted again and again in later military manuals and collections of cases, and became a standard example of a frontier encounter in the Chinese military repertoire. For Heichi Changzhi himself the victory was also the beginning of a tragedy: his military fame brought him into the factional struggles of the Wu Zhou court, and he was executed in Yongchang 1 (689) on a charge of plotting rebellion, so that the Tang lost the officer who knew Turkic warfare best. As for the situation in the north, the reverse at Two Wells did not end the border threat: Guduolu raided south many times afterwards, and only the internal collapse of the Second Turks, with its struggles over succession and between tribes, really opened the space the Tang needed. The histories say very little about the battle, yet it has kept a place of its own in two millennia of military narrative as a frontier engagement won by a small force in a very short time, entirely by rhythm and psychological pressure.
result: 結果是唐軍全勝而無追擊之功可記。資治通鑑的記錄只有寥寥數十字：突厥兵將遇唐騎即下馬穿甲，黑齒常之率二百騎猛力衝擊，突厥猝不及防，棄甲逃走；當日傍晚突厥大軍趕到，準備會戰，黑齒常之令人砍木燃火於營中，突厥遠望疑為烽火，以為朝廷援軍將至，遂退走。從戰術層面看，唐軍達到了逐敵離境、恢復邊境安寧的目的，沒有被突破的邊州、沒有被擄走的民眾、沒有丟失的城池，這在武則天初年邊防普遍吃緊的背景下並非小事；但從戰略層面看，這也只是一場殲滅性極低的勝利，沒有一個被記錄的斬首數、俘虜數或繳械數可以證明敵人主力遭到重創，一支三千人的先鋒被打散之後，草原政權很快又可以重組隊伍。史載有限之處也在此：除了這段資治通鑑的文字，此役的戰場地形、交戰時辰、雙方具體傷亡與後續追擊，幾乎全部無案可查，各種細節在後世轉述中諸說並存。無論如何，此役仍然是武則天時期少數有明確人名、時間與兵力的唐代邊疆戰例，兩井的地名、兩百與三千的數字，以及那堆被砍下來點燃的樹幹，構成了這場戰爭留給後世最完整的記憶。
resultEn: The result was a complete Tang victory, with nothing of a pursuit to record. The Zizhi Tongjian sets it down in a few dozen characters: when the Turk soldiers saw the Tang horsemen they dismounted to put on their armour, Heichi Changzhi drove his two hundred riders in with all force, the Turks were caught unprepared, threw away their armour and ran; that same evening the main Turk army came up, ready to give battle, and Heichi Changzhi had his men cut wood and light fires inside the camp, so that the Turks, looking from afar, suspected beacon fires and, believing reinforcements from the court were coming, withdrew. At the tactical level the Tang had achieved what they set out to do, driving the enemy back out of the border and restoring quiet to the frontier: no border prefecture was overrun, no population was carried off, no city was lost, and in the generally strained frontier situation of the first years of Empress Wu's reign that was no small thing. At the strategic level, however, it was a victory of very low destructiveness: no recorded count of heads taken, of prisoners, or of weapons captured proves that the enemy main body was badly hurt, and once a vanguard of three thousand had been scattered a steppe polity could put its columns together again fairly quickly. The limits of the record show here too: apart from this passage of the Zizhi Tongjian, the terrain, the hour of the engagement, the actual losses on both sides and the pursuit that followed can hardly be looked up at all, and the details differ from one later retelling to the next. Even so, the battle remains one of the few Tang frontier engagements with clearly named commanders, a clear date and clear numbers, and the name of the place, the figures of two hundred and three thousand, together with that pile of felled trees that were set alight, make up the fullest memory the war has left behind.
